HINGE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Mid Back
SECONDARY
Lats, Rhomboids, Biceps

Instructions

Preparation: Straddle the loaded bar or landmine and grip the handles at your shins. Hinge forward to about 45°, chest up, back flat, core braced.

1

Let your arms reach full extension.

2

Keep your back flat and hips still.

3

Draw the handle toward your lower chest.

4

Keep elbows back and both grips closed.

5

Return to straight arms without rounding.

6

Stay hinged; keep both feet planted.

Watch out

Standing up and heaving with the hips. Set a strong hinge, keep it fixed, and row the handle to your chest.

COMMON MISTAKES

Heaving the whole body upright to start each rep.
Letting the lower back round as the weight gets heavy.
Cutting the range short at the bottom so the lats never stretch.
